assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis code I49.9 is assigned
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes
The CPT code 93229 is used for mobile cardiac telemetry
The procedure is medically necessary to evaluate recurrent dizziness and giddiness in the context of the patient's cardiac and cerebrovascular history
